body: Gate design: a session block rule works on hosts without permission but a redirect to an extension page does not, so engine/gate.ts swaps the stopped tab to the gate page with tabs.update. A stopped form POST is recognised through the relay's submit notice (viaForm) and goes back to the form, never resumed as a GET. Full Google sign-in story: docs/how-it-works.md 'Signing in with Google' and docsi/research/google-signin.md section 6.
